title: picea asperata var. retroflexa
intro: Picea asperata var. retroflexa, commonly known as Chinese black spruce, is a type of evergreen coniferous tree native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate fever, making it beneficial for the treatment of conditions such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The therapeutic actions of Chinese black spruce include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
